summary: Frontend-only validation completed on public URL for route refactor, proposals content, local assets, garra usage, and navigation stability.
action_items: No functional fixes required for requested scope.
Optional maintainability: expand heavily minified one-line page components (and App.js) into readable multi-line structure to reduce regression risk in future edits.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js and several pages are compressed into very large one-line JSX expressions, making route-level regression review and safe refactors harder.
Not all interactive inputs consistently expose data-testid (e.g., admin image URL input), reducing deterministic automation coverage for future runs.
seed_data_creation: UI registration test users created: qa.refactor.menu.1791308383@example.com and qa.assets.scan.1791308418@example.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://vision-universitaria.preview.emergentagent.com: bottom nav routes to Inicio/Propuestas/Juegos/Premios/Perfil without errors; Propuestas renders full plan sections including Mensaje y visión, Formación profesional, and six pilares; Inicio branding assets resolve to bundled local static media (logo-rivero-rector, banner-rivero); garra-rivero appears in saldo and currency areas; no customer-assets or external emergentagent asset calls detected during flow; /administracion redirects non-admin user to /perfil as expected.
rca of the issue: During first network scan, one false-positive URL appeared as blob:https://vision-universitaria.preview.emergentagent.com/... when filtering for 'emergentagent'. Root cause: blob URLs inherit origin text and are not external asset hosts. Mitigation: exclude blob: and same-origin requests when checking forbidden external asset sources.
